sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar.
Our order history for this part shows 5.17 EUR (po:4500013023-10) against 5.45 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014455-10).
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered until March 2027.
Our volume forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
Today you supply 80 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 36-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We accept the AS-14404 index clause on the material share with a 5% deadband; the attached base price reflects the price risk this removes for you.
The attached package gives you planning certainty over 36 months.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 94,800 kg per year over 36 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We accept the 36-month contract and the AS-14404 index clause to provide the planning certainty you require. While company policy prevents us from sharing a detailed cost breakdown, we have factored your verified volume increase into our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot is valid for 30 days. Our current offer is a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.47 per unit.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

As requested, our management has reviewed the terms and your binding volume commitment. We have reviewed your latest proposal and verified the delivery record you cited, which we acknowledge. We have already taken that volume change data into account. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, in response to your flexibility on payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.39 per unit for a 36-month contract with 60 days payment, alongside a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and the movement towards our position. We are always eager to support your needs with our dedicated service and comprehensive range. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot), so please decide. Our present offer provides a price of €5.38 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. In response, we can lower our price to €5.34 per unit for the 36-month contract with 60 days payment. As an alternative package, we offer a price of €5.34 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

We confirm that we can meet your required lead time of 10 days. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
